subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft with checklist-style state while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main deliberately collapses progress mode to a compact summary, and the requested full-draft/checklist behavior adds a new public config and Telegram lifecycle policy rather than fixing a broken documented behavior.

options.title: Accept default-off full preservation
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option with checklist-state behavior while preserving the current summary collapse as the default.

options.title: Keep current summary collapse
options.body: Leave progress mode as final answer plus compact activity digest and decline full completed-draft retention for now.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Hold the Telegram-only option until a cross-channel structured progress-card contract can represent checklist state consistently.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off full preservation
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete option with checklist-state behavior while preserving the current summary collapse as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: The current collapse-summary finalization path and progress config shape are currently blamed to Vincent Koc's recent work, making him the best available routing candidate for the policy choice.
